title: Royal Palace of La Almudaina - Wikipedia
content: # Royal Palace of La Almudaina. The **Royal Palace of La Almudaina** (Catalan: *Palau Reial de l'Almudaina*, pronounced ) is one of the official residences of the Spanish royal family.*[citation needed*] Originally an Arab fortress, major alterations were made at the beginning of the 14th century. This imposing alcázar was known at the time of the conquest with the name of "Zuda".*[citation needed*] When King James II of Majorca conquered the kingdom of Majorca, a program was launched in 1298 to reform the appearance of the city. In the same way as in the Royal Palace of Madrid, the Royal Palace of La Almudaina, is the official summer residence of the King, as well as other members of the Spanish royal family, who also reside in the Palace of Marivent and in the Palacio de la Zarzuela in Madrid.
